newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE sets intraday record ahead of U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE sets intraday record ahead of U.S. data.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index of leading shares climbed to record levels on Friday in early trading, after an encouraging turnaround on Wall Street overnight.
But investors remained wary ahead of key U.S. payrolls data due later in the day.
UK's FTSE sets intraday record ahead of U.S. =2
The FTSE 100 index added 21.2 points to 4,287.1 by 0913 GMT, surpassing the previous intraday high of 4,286.9 set on Wednesday this week.
Traders said the early gains were inspired by a solid performance in New York overnight. The Dow recovered to be up 27 points yesterday after suffering a sharp sell-off on Wednesday.
But investors remained cautious and all eyes were fixed on U.S. employment figures for January due at 1330 GMT.
Payrolls are expected to have risen by around 237,000 in January but a larger than expected jump in employment could trigger fears that the U.S. economy is overheating.
